mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC >0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate crossing above 4.5% triggers a negative labor market sentiment that dampens equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators creates expansionary momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both proxies rising in the same direction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations for positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when FEDFUNDS drop in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS) creates conflicting signals, yet their joint effect in labor market recovery drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite UNRATE falling and FEDFUNDS rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid expansion in supply (INDPRO) exceeding 115 (15% growth) triggers excess capacity concerns, leading to short-term negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns not negative when INDPRO exceeds 115 in expansionary regime.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates below 4% in a post-shock recovery regime signal accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when FEDFUNDS <4% in post-shock regime, or IC >0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in employment (PAYEMS) and simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) create strong labor market confidence, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns negative despite both PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling.
